// Optional file-only reference producer. Never run by ordinary Pulse tests.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/model/histogram"
	collector "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/metrics/v1"
	common "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/common/v1"
	metrics "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/metrics/v1"
	resource "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/resource/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

type Geometry struct {
	Name                string `json:"name"`
	Scale               int32  `json:"scale"`
	Index               int32  `json:"index"`
	Negative            bool   `json:"negative"`
	Bound               string `json:"bound_bits"`
	DirectExp2          string `json:"direct_exp2_bits"`
	PrometheusBound     string `json:"prometheus_bound_bits,omitempty"`
	PrometheusInclusive bool   `json:"prometheus_upper_inclusive"`
}

func bits(v float64) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%016x", math.Float64bits(v)) }
func attr(key, value string) *common.KeyValue {
	return &common.KeyValue{Key: key, Value: &common.AnyValue{Value: &common.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue: value}}}
}
func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("expected output directory")
	}
	directory := os.Args[1]
	if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0755); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var geometry []Geometry
	var points []*metrics.ExponentialHistogramDataPoint
	for scale := int32(-10); scale <= 3; scale++ {
		indices := map[int32]bool{}
		for i := int32(-12); i <= 12; i++ {
			indices[i] = true
		}
		for _, exponent := range []float64{-1075, -1074, -1022, 1023, 1024} {
			center := int32(math.Floor(math.Ldexp(exponent, int(scale))))
			for j := int32(-3); j <= 3; j++ {
				indices[center+j] = true
			}
		}
		// Deterministic sorted enumeration, not map iteration order.
		for index := int32(-9000); index <= 9000; index++ {
			if !indices[index] {
				continue
			}
			for _, negative := range []bool{false, true} {
				name := fmt.Sprintf("s%d_i%d_n%t", scale, index, negative)
				exponent := math.Ldexp(float64(index), -int(scale))
				// Decompose before Exp2: this toolchain's direct Exp2(-1074.5)
				// returns zero whereas Ldexp and the public histogram iterator retain
				// the nearest subnormal. Preserve both observations in the capture.
				integral := math.Floor(exponent)
				bound := math.Ldexp(math.Exp2(exponent-integral), int(integral))
				direct := math.Exp2(exponent)
				if negative {
					bound = -bound
					direct = -direct
				}
				g := Geometry{Name: name, Scale: scale, Index: index, Negative: negative, Bound: bits(bound), DirectExp2: bits(direct)}
				if scale >= -4 {
					h := &histogram.FloatHistogram{Schema: scale, Count: 1}
					var iterator histogram.BucketIterator[float64]
					if negative {
						h.NegativeSpans = []histogram.Span{{Offset: index + 1, Length: 1}}
						h.NegativeBuckets = []float64{1}
						iterator = h.NegativeBucketIterator()
					} else {
						h.PositiveSpans = []histogram.Span{{Offset: index, Length: 1}}
						h.PositiveBuckets = []float64{1}
						iterator = h.PositiveBucketIterator()
					}
					if !iterator.Next() {
						panic("missing public bucket")
					}
					b := iterator.At()
					g.PrometheusBound = bits(b.Upper)
					g.PrometheusInclusive = b.UpperInclusive
				}
				geometry = append(geometry, g)
				p := &metrics.ExponentialHistogramDataPoint{TimeUnixNano: 1700000000123456789, StartTimeUnixNano: 1700000000000000000, Scale: scale, Count: 1, Attributes: []*common.KeyValue{attr("case", name)}}
				offset := index - 1
				if negative {
					offset = index
				}
				bucket := &metrics.ExponentialHistogramDataPoint_Buckets{Offset: offset, BucketCounts: []uint64{1}}
				if negative {
					p.Negative = bucket
				} else {
					p.Positive = bucket
				}
				points = append(points, p)
			}
		}
	}
	// One full request preserves public typed owners and exact source timestamps.
	request := &collector.ExportMetricsServiceRequest{ResourceMetrics: []*metrics.ResourceMetrics{{
		Resource: &resource.Resource{Attributes: []*common.KeyValue{attr("service.name", "public-exp-reference")}, DroppedAttributesCount: 2}, SchemaUrl: "https://example.invalid/resource-schema",
		ScopeMetrics: []*metrics.ScopeMetrics{{Scope: &common.InstrumentationScope{Name: "public-exp-reference", Version: "1", Attributes: []*common.KeyValue{attr("scope-key", "scope-value")}, DroppedAttributesCount: 3}, SchemaUrl: "https://example.invalid/scope-schema", Metrics: []*metrics.Metric{{Name: "exp_geometry", Description: "synthetic boundary controls", Unit: "s", Data: &metrics.Metric_ExponentialHistogram{ExponentialHistogram: &metrics.ExponentialHistogram{AggregationTemporality: metrics.AggregationTemporality_AGGREGATION_TEMPORALITY_CUMULATIVE, DataPoints: points}}}}}},
	}}}
	raw, err := proto.MarshalOptions{Deterministic: true}.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	text, err := protojson.MarshalOptions{UseEnumNumbers: true}.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var roundtrip collector.ExportMetricsServiceRequest
	if err = protojson.Unmarshal(text, &roundtrip); err != nil || !proto.Equal(request, &roundtrip) {
		panic("public JSON roundtrip")
	}
	encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(geometry, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for name, data := range map[string][]byte{"request.protobuf": raw, "request.json": text, "geometry.json": encoded} {
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, name), data, 0644); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
	fmt.Printf("%d public protobuf points and mathematical geometry controls\n", len(points))
}
